environment.description: NestJS microservice deployed on EC2 instance (i-0a3f7c2e) in us-east-1, running as root user inside Docker container with host networking mode. IMDSv1 enabled on the instance. No network policies restricting outbound traffic from the container. Service accessible on port 3000 via public ALB with no WAF rules attached. Container runs with default seccomp profile and no filesystem restrictions.
